term: first contingent concrete count threshold in one temporal history
definition: AtLeastAt h Concrete v n t is an injective map Fin n to distinct beings, each concrete, ContingentAt h.ontic v, and temporally present at t. note: A7 motivates the proposed interpretation; no source claim identifies these strengthened guarded configurations with its reports.
